assertions.name: wall_excess_is_an_algebraic_rewrite_of_B_over_A
assertions.unit: worst relative difference over the chain
assertions.source: B/(2(A-1)B(2)) == (B/A)/(2B(2)) * A/(A-1) identically, so the 1.9123 saturation is the ordinary volume term rescaled and is NOT new information

assertions.name: deviation_is_concentrated_at_A4_and_A6
assertions.unit: ratio of the smaller light anomaly to the A=16 residual
assertions.source: A=4 +19.50%, A=6 -21.42%, A=8 +1.35%, A=12 +1.22%, A=16 -0.02%: a light-nucleus term that has saturated by 16

description: The N=Z self-conjugate chain (2H,4He,6Li,8Be,12C,16O) has no mirror partner and hence no convention choice, giving ~8 digits against the consecutive-A cumulant tower's <1. But its leading content is an algebraic rewrite of the ordinary B/A saturation, NOT new information; the extensive term lives only in the residual after a volume+surface background, concentrated at A=4 (+19.5%) and A=6 (-21.4%) and dead by A=16 (-0.02%). The residual is fit-form dependent, so it becomes a zero-parameter target only once the framework supplies the background instead of least squares. Scope-(a).

volume_surface_fit.form: B = a*A + b*A^(2/3), 2 params on 5 points

limitation.convention_ambiguity: removed -- N=Z has no mirror partner
limitation.fit_form_ambiguity: introduced -- 2 params on 5 points; a different background form gives different residuals, so the ~8 digits are of a fit-dependent quantity
limitation.what_would_fix_it: subtract the FRAMEWORK's own volume background (qou-brng saturated fraction) instead of least squares; the A=4 and A=6 residuals then become convention-free, AME-precise, zero-parameter targets
